description: Draw with the shape and pen tools: rectangles (with rounded corners), ellipses, triangles, polygons, stars, lines, custom shape presets and pen points, combined with path operations. Mode shape makes a shape layer filled with a colour; path adds a path to the Paths panel; pixels fills the shape on the active layer

antiAlias.description: pixels: smooth the edges. Default true

color.description: Fill colour for shape and pixels modes. Default: the foreground colour

components.description: The shape's components, drawn in order; each one's operation combines it with those before it

items.description: One path component. rectangle, ellipse, triangle, polygon, star and custom fill the box x, y, width, height; line runs from "from" to "to"; points follows the anchor points as the Pen tools draw them

closed.description: points: close the path back to the first point. Default true

cornerRadius.description: rectangle: radius of the rounded corners in pixels, one number or [top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left]

curve.description: points: give points without handles smooth curves through their neighbours, as the Curvature and Freeform Pen tools do. Default false

indent.description: star: indent sides by this percent of the radius. Default 50

name.description: custom: the custom shape preset name (Shapes panel)

operation.description: Path operation with the components before it: combine shapes (default), subtract front shape, intersect shape areas or exclude overlapping shapes

points.description: points: anchor points in drawing order

items.description: An anchor point, with optional direction handles

handleIn.description: Direction point of the segment arriving at this anchor. Default: the anchor (no curve)

handleOut.description: Direction point of the segment leaving this anchor. Default: the anchor (no curve)

smooth.description: A smooth point (handles move together) rather than a corner point

shape.description: Rectangle, Ellipse, Triangle, Polygon, Star, Line or Custom Shape tool, or pen points

sides.description: polygon: number of sides; star: number of points. Default 5

mode.description: Tool mode: shape layer (default), path, or pixels

name.description: Name of the new shape layer, or of the new path (default "Path", numbered if taken)

name: draw_vector_shape
title: Draw Vector Shape
